review_notes:
I read the whole file. It defines `FunctorToTypes.monoFactorisation`, `monoFactorisationIsImage`, a `HasImages (C ⥤ Type*)` instance and a `HasStrongEpiMonoFactorisations` instance. I compared these with the existing image machinery in Mathlib:
- `Limits/Types/Images.lean` gives `monoFactorisation`/`isImage` for `Type u` only. It is the pointwise case, not the functor-category one.
- `Sites/Subsheaf.lean` gives `imageMonoFactorization` and `imageFactorization` for `Sheaf J (Type _)`. This is a different category and a different construction, because it sheafifies.
- `Algebra/Category/Grp/Images.lean` and `Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Images.lean` cover other categories.
- The only image-related declarations I found for `C ⥤ Type*` are in the target file itself.

The file builds on `Subfunctor.range` and `Subfunctor.toRange`, so it reuses the existing subfunctor API rather than defining a parallel notion. The `Type`-valued `monoFactorisation` and the functor-valued one are specialisations in different categories, not competing definitions of one concept. I found no avoidable duplicate of a Mathlib concept. I did not read `Subfunctor/Image.lean` in full, so I can't rule out a duplicate there, but I saw no sign of one.
